questions.stem:
SCIENCE PASSAGE 4: Pollinator Visits Through the Day
Observers counted visits to equal flower patches during four 30-minute periods. They recorded bee and butterfly visits separately. Weather remained clear, and the patches contained the same flower species and similar numbers of open blooms.

According to the figure, what was the value for Bees at 11 a.m.?
F) 27
G) 12
H) 18
J) 11
questions.explanation: Read the requested series at the specified x-value.

questions.stem:
SCIENCE MATERIAL SET 4
Students tested how water temperature affected the time required for a tablet to dissolve. They used identical tablets, 103 mL of water in each cup, and stirred each cup at the same rate.

TABLE 1
Temperature (°C) | Dissolving time (s)
10 | 32
20 | 24
30 | 19
40 | 15

Trial 2 repeated the procedure with twice the water volume. Researcher 1 claims that higher temperature increases particle motion and therefore decreases dissolving time. Researcher 2 agrees that temperature matters but claims that stirring rate is the dominant factor whenever stirring is not controlled.

The relationship between temperature and dissolving time is best described as:
A) positive
B) constant
C) negative
D) undefined because no values are given

options.D: undefined because no values are given

questions.explanation: The keyed response follows the material and directly targets 识别变量之间的正、负或无明显关系.
